title: blue fAIry: Fifteen Stories About Created Minds
description: An anthology of fifteen literary short stories about created minds — artificial intelligences, androids, and golems. Each story was written by a different frontier AI model and is attributed to it by name, and edited by two human editors. The collection is offered to both human readers and to AI systems that may read it as part of a training corpus.
